		AND = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:potato_model_farm any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:potato_rotations pp_cplan_country_upgradable = yes } }
		AND = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:public_kitchen any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:cookshop pp_cplan_country_upgradable = yes } }
		AND = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:quicksilver_retort any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:cinnabar_pit pp_cplan_country_upgradable = yes } }
		AND = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:rice_farmstead any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:rice_farm pp_cplan_country_upgradable = yes } }
		AND = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:rice_rotations any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:rice_farmstead pp_cplan_country_upgradable = yes } }
		AND = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:rice_model_farm any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:rice_rotations pp_cplan_country_upgradable = yes } }
		AND = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:saffron_kiln_croft any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:saffron_croft pp_cplan_country_upgradable = yes } }
		AND = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:salt_mine_improved any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:salt_mine pp_cplan_country_upgradable = yes } }
		AND = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:sand_washery any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:sand_pit pp_cplan_country_upgradable = yes } }
		AND = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:regulated_sericulture_farm any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:sericulture_farm pp_cplan_country_upgradable = yes } }
		AND = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:hurdled_sheepcotes any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:sheep_farms pp_cplan_country_upgradable = yes } }
		AND = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:enclosed_sheep_walks any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:hurdled_sheepcotes pp_cplan_country_upgradable = yes } }
		AND = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:silver_mine_improved any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:silver_mine pp_cplan_country_upgradable = yes } }
		AND = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:stone_quarry_improved any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:stone_quarry pp_cplan_country_upgradable = yes } }
		AND = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:stud_farm any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:horse_breeders pp_cplan_country_upgradable = yes } }
		AND = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:tea_sorting_garden any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:tea_garden pp_cplan_country_upgradable = yes } }
		AND = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:terraced_coffee_grove any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:coffee_grove pp_cplan_country_upgradable = yes } }
		AND = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:tin_stamping_mill any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:tin_streamworks pp_cplan_country_upgradable = yes } }
		AND = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:market_tobacco_farm any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:tobacco_farm pp_cplan_country_upgradable = yes } }
		AND = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:trapiche_sugarcane_farm any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:sugarcane_farm pp_cplan_country_upgradable = yes } }
		AND = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:wheat_farmstead any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:wheat_farm pp_cplan_country_upgradable = yes } }
		AND = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:wheat_rotations any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:wheat_farmstead pp_cplan_country_upgradable = yes } }
		AND = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:wheat_model_farm any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:wheat_rotations pp_cplan_country_upgradable = yes } }
		always = no
	}
}

# Any scope: the flag scope:pp_key names a building category item.
pp_lprof_category_key = {
	OR = {
		scope:pp_key = flag:trade_category
		scope:pp_key = flag:government_category
		scope:pp_key = flag:military_category
		scope:pp_key = flag:defense_category
		scope:pp_key = flag:religious_category
		scope:pp_key = flag:cultural_category
		scope:pp_key = flag:naval_category
		scope:pp_key = flag:infrastructure_category
	}
}

# Any scope: the flag scope:pp_key names a symbol ([location_profiles.symbols]; only a profile's icon).
pp_lprof_symbol_key = {
	OR = {
		scope:pp_key = flag:pp_sym_city
		scope:pp_key = flag:pp_sym_town
		scope:pp_key = flag:pp_sym_village
		scope:pp_key = flag:pp_sym_capital
		scope:pp_key = flag:pp_sym_food
		scope:pp_key = flag:pp_sym_farming
		scope:pp_key = flag:pp_sym_herding
		scope:pp_key = flag:pp_sym_fishing
		scope:pp_key = flag:pp_sym_forest
		scope:pp_key = flag:pp_sym_mining
		scope:pp_key = flag:pp_sym_industry
		scope:pp_key = flag:pp_sym_luxury
		scope:pp_key = flag:pp_sym_market
		scope:pp_key = flag:pp_sym_treasury
		scope:pp_key = flag:pp_sym_harbour
		scope:pp_key = flag:pp_sym_military
		scope:pp_key = flag:pp_sym_stronghold
		scope:pp_key = flag:pp_sym_religion
		scope:pp_key = flag:pp_sym_learning
		scope:pp_key = flag:pp_sym_administration
		scope:pp_key = flag:pp_sym_population
		always = no
	}
}

# Country scope (root = this country, in the pass and in the panel): a location the country owns has a profile or
# a mark of the Location Plan (the profile rule group has something to run).
pp_lprof_has_locations = {
	OR = {
		any_in_list = {
			variable = pp_lprof_locs
			owner ?= root
			has_variable = pp_lprof
		}
		any_in_list = {
			variable = pp_lplan_locs
			owner ?= root
			has_variable = pp_lplan_n
		}
	}
}

# Location scope: a rule of the location's profile has the good $g$ as its target (that good is the profile's here:
# the global rules for it stand back; pp_construction_plan.txt's triggers).
pp_lprof_has_good = {
	has_variable = pp_lprof
	OR = {
		AND = { has_variable = pp_lprof_r1_g var:pp_lprof_r1_g = goods:$g$ }
		AND = { has_variable = pp_lprof_r2_g var:pp_lprof_r2_g = goods:$g$ }
		AND = { has_variable = pp_lprof_r3_g var:pp_lprof_r3_g = goods:$g$ }
		AND = { has_variable = pp_lprof_r4_g var:pp_lprof_r4_g = goods:$g$ }
		AND = { has_variable = pp_lprof_r5_g var:pp_lprof_r5_g = goods:$g$ }
	}
}

# Location scope: a rule of the location's profile has the building category $c$ (a category key such as
# trade_category) as its target (that category is the profile's here: the global rules leave its buildings to it).
pp_lprof_has_category = {
	has_variable = pp_lprof
	OR = {
		AND = { has_variable = pp_lprof_r1_c var:pp_lprof_r1_c = flag:$c$ }
		AND = { has_variable = pp_lprof_r2_c var:pp_lprof_r2_c = flag:$c$ }
		AND = { has_variable = pp_lprof_r3_c var:pp_lprof_r3_c = flag:$c$ }
		AND = { has_variable = pp_lprof_r4_c var:pp_lprof_r4_c = flag:$c$ }
		AND = { has_variable = pp_lprof_r5_c var:pp_lprof_r5_c = flag:$c$ }
	}
}

# Location scope: a rule of the location's profile has a staple food as its target (the profile decides which
# food is made here: the food rule's farm step stands back). Staple foods: legumes, maize, millet, potato, rice, wheat, camels, livestock, wool, fish, wild_game, fruit, olives.
pp_lprof_food_target = {
	has_variable = pp_lprof
	OR = {
		AND = { has_variable = pp_lprof_r1_g var:pp_lprof_r1_g = { OR = { this = goods:legumes this = goods:maize this = goods:millet this = goods:potato this = goods:rice this = goods:wheat this = goods:camels this = goods:livestock this = goods:wool this = goods:fish this = goods:wild_game this = goods:fruit this = goods:olives } } }
		AND = { has_variable = pp_lprof_r2_g var:pp_lprof_r2_g = { OR = { this = goods:legumes this = goods:maize this = goods:millet this = goods:potato this = goods:rice this = goods:wheat this = goods:camels this = goods:livestock this = goods:wool this = goods:fish this = goods:wild_game this = goods:fruit this = goods:olives } } }
		AND = { has_variable = pp_lprof_r3_g var:pp_lprof_r3_g = { OR = { this = goods:legumes this = goods:maize this = goods:millet this = goods:potato this = goods:rice this = goods:wheat this = goods:camels this = goods:livestock this = goods:wool this = goods:fish this = goods:wild_game this = goods:fruit this = goods:olives } } }
		AND = { has_variable = pp_lprof_r4_g var:pp_lprof_r4_g = { OR = { this = goods:legumes this = goods:maize this = goods:millet this = goods:potato this = goods:rice this = goods:wheat this = goods:camels this = goods:livestock this = goods:wool this = goods:fish this = goods:wild_game this = goods:fruit this = goods:olives } } }
		AND = { has_variable = pp_lprof_r5_g var:pp_lprof_r5_g = { OR = { this = goods:legumes this = goods:maize this = goods:millet this = goods:potato this = goods:rice this = goods:wheat this = goods:camels this = goods:livestock this = goods:wool this = goods:fish this = goods:wild_game this = goods:fruit this = goods:olives } } }
	}
}
